entity_kinds.label: Release
entity_kinds.description: A catalog entity describing one published release.

entity_kinds.label: Master
entity_kinds.description: A catalog entity grouping the releases of one work of record.

entity_kinds.label: Artist
entity_kinds.description: A catalog entity describing a performing or credited party.

entity_kinds.label: Label
entity_kinds.description: A catalog entity describing an issuing label.

entity_kinds.label: Artifact
entity_kinds.description: One specific edition of a release-kind catalog item, creatable by a user when no catalog match exists.

entity_kinds.label: Owned copy
entity_kinds.description: A physical copy a user holds, identified natively rather than by a provider collection row.

entity_kinds.label: Collection snapshot
entity_kinds.description: A user's collection membership at an instant, content-hashed.

entity_kinds.label: Observation
entity_kinds.description: User-captured evidence about an owned copy or an artifact: kind, value, source, confidence, and observation time.

providers.label: Discogs
providers.description: Identifiers assigned by the Discogs catalog.

providers.label: MusicBrainz
providers.description: Identifiers assigned by the MusicBrainz catalog.

providers.label: Barcode
providers.description: A printed product barcode carried by a physical edition.

providers.label: Catalogue number
providers.description: A catalogue number assigned by an issuing label.

providers.label: ISRC
providers.description: An International Standard Recording Code carried by a recording.

providers.label: Matrix inscription
providers.description: A matrix or runout inscription stamped into a physical copy.

sources.label: Catalog
sources.description: The alias was read from the provider's own catalog during ingestion.

sources.label: Inference
sources.description: A matching heuristic proposed the alias; it is evidence, not an assertion.
